title: CW-BASE100 Variable-Depth Token Codec
negative_results: an odd-length token string is refused (decode_to_path raises; decode returns INVALID)
a non-ASCII-digit token (including unicode superscript digits) is refused
encode refuses a token value outside [0, 99], a bool, or a string passed as a path

claims.statement: CW-BASE100-1 is a variable-depth grammar of two-decimal-digit tokens (00..99); a string of N tokens decodes to a depth-N path and encode/decode round-trip exactly.
The exact round-trip is a verified property of the codec, not evidence that any decoded path identifies a real location; source-vector geographic semantics remain NOT_CLAIMED.
A malformed token string (odd length or non-ASCII-digit) yields an explicit INVALID result or a ClaimError, never a silent repair.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
